observation.command: cd /workspace; grep -oE "@sw-code/[a-z0-9-]+" app/pnpm-lock.yaml | sort -u > /tmp/lock_swcode.txt; wc -l /tmp/lock_swcode.txt; echo ---; find app/libs -name package.json -exec grep -h '"name"' {} \; | grep -oE "@sw-code/[a-z0-9-]+" | sort -u > /tmp/ws_swcode.txt; wc -l /tmp/ws_swcode.txt; echo "--- external (in lock but not workspace) ---"; comm -23 /tmp/lock_swcode.txt /tmp/ws_swcode.txt
